servinfo.title: RBS Control Module Removal and Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: RBS Control Module Components:Adaptive Cruise Control

attention4.ptxt: Removal of RBS control module may weaken clips’ retaining force and cause looseness or dropping off of RBS control module after reinstallation.
Replace the clips with new ones when reinstalling RBS control module.

s1.ptxt: Remove RBS control module inner cover (1).
Disconnect connector and remove RBS control module (2).

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Insert new clip to RBS control module bracket (2) at each hole and turn it clockwise until it stops.
Tighten RBS control module bracket nuts to specified torque.
Install RBS control module (1) inserting aiming bolts (2) to clips (3) until tightness is felt.
When RBS control module is replaced with new one, perform Millimeter Wave Radar Variant Registration:Adaptive Cruise Control .
After installation, perform Millimeter Wave Radar Aiming Adjustment:Adaptive Cruise Control .
Check that RBS control module inner cover surface (1) is flush with the top surface (3) of the RBS control module (2).
